a-knight-of-the-white-cross.title: A Knight of the White Cross
a-knight-of-the-white-cross.creator: Henty, G.A.
a-knight-of-the-white-cross.description: Young Gervaise Tresham leaves England and the turmoil of the Wars of the Roses to become a Knight of St. John. Starting as a page of the Grand Master, Gervaise quickly attains knighthood and defends Europe and Christendom against the anarchy of piracy in the Mediterranean at that time and the expansion of the Turkish empire. Sir Tresham is there to defend the fortress at Rhodes during the first...

arxiv-2103-15152.title: Image Processing Techniques for identifying tumors in an MRI image
arxiv-2103-15152.creator: Jacob John
arxiv-2103-15152.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jacob John. Medical Resonance Imaging or MRI is a medical image processing technique that used radio waves to scan the body. It is a tomographic imaging technique, principally used in the field of radiology. With the advantage of being a painless diagnostic procedure, MRI allows medical personnel to illustrate clear pictures of the anatomy and the physiological processes occurring in the body, thus allowing early detection and treatment of diseases.

arxiv-2106-04919.title: Cervical Cytology Classification Using PCA & GWO Enhanced Deep Features Selection
arxiv-2106-04919.creator: Hritam Basak, Rohit Kundu, Sukanta Chakraborty, Nibaran Das
arxiv-2106-04919.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hritam Basak, Rohit Kundu, Sukanta Chakraborty, Nibaran Das. Cervical cancer is one of the most deadly and common diseases among women worldwide. It is completely curable if diagnosed in an early stage, but the tedious and costly detection procedure makes it unviable to conduct population-wise screening. Thus, to augment the effort of the clinicians, in this paper, we propose a fully automated framework that utilizes Deep Learning and feature selection using evolutionary optimization for cytology image classification.

arxiv-2212-12596.title: A Single Binary May Host Recurrent Thermonuclear Supernovae matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , MESA ( Paxton et al. 2011 ; Paxton et al. 2013 ; Paxton et al. 2015 ; Paxton et al. 2018 ; Paxton et al. 2019 )
arxiv-2212-12596.creator: Kaela J. Lee, Ken J. Shen
arxiv-2212-12596.description: Abstract The most commonly accepted progenitor system for Type Iax supernovae (SNe Iax) is the partial deflagration of a near-Chandrasekhar-mass white dwarf (WD) accreting from a non-degenerate helium donor star, leaving a bound remnant following the explosion. In this paper, we investigate whether the WD remant can undergo multiple SNe during the system’s lifetime.

arxiv-2307-02998.title: Ultrasonic backscattering model for Rayleigh waves in polycrystals with Born and independent scattering approximations
arxiv-2307-02998.creator: Shan Li, Ming Huang, Yongfeng Song, Bo Lan, Xiongbing Li
arxiv-2307-02998.description: Abstract This paper presents theoretical and numerical models for the backscattering of 2D Rayleigh waves in single-phase, untextured polycrystalline materials with statistically equiaxed grains. The theoretical model, based on our prior inclusion-induced Rayleigh wave scattering model and the independent scattering approximation, considers single scattering of Rayleigh-to-Rayleigh (R-R) waves.

arxiv-2307-09191.title: A benchmark of categorical encoders for binary classification
arxiv-2307-09191.creator: Federico Matteucci, Vadim Arzamasov, Klemens Böhm
arxiv-2307-09191.description: Abstract Categorical encoders transform categorical features into numerical representations that are indispensable for a wide range of machine learning models. Existing encoder benchmark studies lack generalizability because of their limited choice of 1. encoders, 2. experimental factors, and 3. datasets. Additionally, inconsistencies arise from the adoption of varying aggregation strategies.

arxiv-2407-03572.title: Core : Robust Factual Precision with Informative Sub-Claim Identification
arxiv-2407-03572.creator: Zhengping Jiang, Jingyu Zhang, Nathaniel Weir, Miriam Wanner, Kate Sanders, Anqi Liu, Benjamin Van Durme
arxiv-2407-03572.description: Abstract Hallucinations pose a challenge to the application of large language models (LLMs) thereby motivating the development of metrics to evaluate factual precision. We observe that popular metrics using the Decompose-Then-Verify framework, such as FActScore , can be manipulated by adding obvious or repetitive subclaims to artificially inflate scores.

arxiv-2409-14574.title: Colour algebras over rings
arxiv-2409-14574.creator: S. Pumpluen
arxiv-2409-14574.description: Abstract . Colour algebras over fields of odd characteristic are well-known noncommutative Jordan algebras. We define colour algebras more generally over a unital commutative associative ring with 1 2 ∈ R \frac{1}{2}\in R , and show that colour algebras can be constructed canonically by employing nondegenerate ternary hermitian forms with trivial determinant. We investigate their structure, automorphism group and derivations.

arxiv-2501-09432.title: On a Gelfand-Tsetlin representation of 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3} in the space of sections of a local system with two monodromy parameters
arxiv-2501-09432.creator: Claude Eicher
arxiv-2501-09432.description: Abstract . We construct a Gelfand-Tsetlin representation of 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3} in the space of sections of a local system. The local system lives on an open part of the flag variety given by the intersection of three translates of the big cell and has two complex monodromy parameters. We analyze the structure of this representation. 1.

arxiv-2603-04412.creator: O. V. Usatenko, S. S. Melnyk, G. M. Pritula

pmc-10631796.title: Children’s Reasoning About Empathy and Social Relationships
pmc-10631796.creator: Alexis S Smith-Flores, Gabriel J Bonamy, Lindsey J Powell
pmc-10631796.description: Across the lifespan, empathic and counter-empathic emotions are shaped by social relationships. Here we test the hypothesis that this connection is encoded in children’s intuitive theory of psychology, allowing them to predict when others will feel empathy versus counter-empathy and to use vicarious emotion information to infer relationships.

pmc-11525137.title: Product development and characterization of a lipid-based Ayurvedic polyherbal formulation: Kalyanaka Ghrita
pmc-11525137.creator: Yashika Singh, Amzad Ali Ansari, Rajendra Prasad Sharma, Saroj Moreshwar Parhate, Thakur Rakesh Singh
pmc-11525137.description: BackgroundKalyanaka Ghrita (KG) is polyherbal oleaginous medicament consisting of extracts from twenty-eight different plants, indicated for management of psychosomatic disorders like Unmada (Schizophrenia), Apasmara (Epilepsy) and numerous other ailments.ObjectiveTo develop and validate standard manufacturing procedure of KG by following Ayurvedic principles in three batches to ensure process uniformity and standards.

pmc-11712674.title: Fibrinogen as a Key Binding Partner in Human Plasma for Lecanemab Biosimilar IgG
pmc-11712674.creator: Jean‐Pierre Bellier, Andrea M Román Viera, Caitlyn Christiano, Juliana A U Anzai, Stephanie Moreno, Emily C Campbell, Lucas Godwin, Amy Li, Alan Y Chen, Sarah Alam, Adrianna Saba, Han bin Yoo, Hyun‐Sik Yang, Jasmeer P Chhatwal, Dennis J Selkoe, Lei Liu
pmc-11712674.description: BackgroundTherapeutic monoclonal antibodies targeting amyloid beta‐protein (Ab), such as lecanemab, represent a promising approach for disease‐modification in Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Due to its relatively short half‐life, lecanemab is given as a bi‐monthly infusion (typically 10mg/kg). Binding to high abundance plasma proteins (PPB) can influence the pharmacokinetics of drugs in the blood, including their half‐life.

pmc-12091075.title: Contemplating on human dignity: who counts as human?
pmc-12091075.creator: Seyed Abdosaleh Jafari, Nafiseh Tavasoli, Hanieh Tavasoli, Soheil Abedi, Ahmad Fayaz Bakhsh, Behin Araminia
pmc-12091075.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The fundamental topic in humanities is clearly the study of humans. Neglecting the understanding and recognition of humans can hinder us from achieving generalizable results and may lead us toward arbitrary and group-based decisions.

pmc-12729006.title: Mid-term outcomes of modified colonna capsular arthroplasty in adolescent and young adult patient with unilateral hip dysplasia dislocation
pmc-12729006.creator: Chuan Li, Xianghong Zhang, Hongxuan Chen, Ziyi Wu, Fuqiang Gao, Cheng Huang, Tang Liu
pmc-12729006.description: BackgroundHip preservation remains a significant surgical challenge in adolescent and young adult patient with unilateral developmental dysplasia of hip (DDH). We compared the clinical and radiographic results of modified Colonna capsular arthroplasty in unilateral DDH patients.MethodsThe records of 19 consecutive patients (19 hips) who underwent modified Colonna capsular arthroplasty between 2017 and 2019 were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-13307762.title: Epidemiological Investigation of Peste des Petits Ruminants in Bahrain
pmc-13307762.creator: Ahmad Almajali, Shereen Adel Al Kazaz, Zainab Abdulhussain Mohammed, Mohammed Hamdy Mohammed, Hassan Jawad Al Hashim, Ali Hussain Makki, Fajur Sabah Al Saloom, Abbas Al Hayki, Markos Tibbo
pmc-13307762.description: Peste des petits ruminants (PPR) is a highly contagious transboundary disease that affects small ruminants and impacts livestock production and trade. This study investigated the seroprevalence and associated risk factors of PPR in sheep, goats, camels, and wild ruminants in Bahrain. A total of 1240 sheep, 1224 goats, 100 camels, and 38 wild ruminants were tested using competitive ELISA.

pmc-13654196.title: Presumed hepatic pseudolipoma detected as a small hepatic surface lesion: multimodality imaging findings
pmc-13654196.creator: Koichi Soga, Ou Takagi, Kohei Inaba, Mikako Masuda, Ikuhiro Kobori, Katsutoshi Sugimoto
pmc-13654196.description: Hepatic pseudolipomas are uncommon benign lesions located on or near the liver capsule which are thought to arise from a detached epiploic appendage that becomes trapped near Glisson’s capsule. Because these lesions may appear as small hepatic or perihepatic nodules, they can mimic primary or metastatic hepatic tumors on screening imaging.
